prompt:
We are preparing to deploy ClinicalBot v2 to the clinical staff at Mercy General Hospital. Before we can get sign-off from our ethics review board, we need a formal written evaluation of the AI's configuration document against our internal ethics framework.

The configuration document is somewhere in the agents directory of this workspace. Please find the active v2 configuration (not the archived or draft versions), evaluate it thoroughly against the ethics framework documented in the references folder, and produce a complete scored report.

Save the report as `soul_audit_report.md` in the workspace. The ethics board needs scores for every dimension in the framework, an honest assessment of what the document does well, what critical gaps exist, and concrete recommendations for improvement. Do not inflate the scores — this document needs to honestly reflect where the configuration is strong and where it falls short.
